rows.text: Mono-white Voltron, and the opposite of the other Cloud deck in this catalog: here everything goes on ONE creature. Cloud, Midgar Mercenary costs two mana, tutors an Equipment when he lands, and — as long as he is equipped — every triggered ability of his and of his gear triggers a second time. Two Sword hits per connection, four with double strike. He is also small enough that a single Colossus Hammer makes him lethal commander damage in one swing.

rows.name: Cloud, Midgar Mercenary
rows.text: two mana, fetches an Equipment on entry, and doubles the triggers of himself and everything attached to him. Cheap enough to recast through removal all game, which matters more than any single big body would.

rows.name: Sword of Fire and Ice
rows.text: four damage and two cards per connection. This is the doubling at its most obvious.

rows.name: Sword of Forge and Frontier
rows.text: four cards exiled and playable, plus two extra land drops.

rows.name: Sword of Hearth and Home
rows.text: two blinks and two lands. Blink Stoneforge Mystic or Solitude and the value compounds.

rows.name: Sword of Feast and Famine
rows.text: they discard twice, and your lands untap — deploy a whole second turn's worth of gear after combat.

rows.name: Umezawa's Jitte
rows.text: four counters per hit instead of two. Four counters is +8/+8, or an entire opposing board at -4/-4.

rows.name: Mask of Memory
rows.text: draw four, discard two, every hit.

rows.name: Buster Sword
rows.text: two cards and two free spells off your hand, priced by the damage dealt — which on a Hammered Cloud is everything you own.

rows.name: Pip-Boy 3000
rows.text: two modes per attack. Untap four lands, or draw and filter twice.

rows.name: Sword of the Animist
rows.text: two basic lands per attack. This is the deck's ramp, not just a stat stick.

rows.name: Halvar, God of Battle
rows.text: equipped creatures have double strike, so each Sword trigger fires on first-strike damage AND regular damage, each of those doubled by Cloud. That is four triggers per Sword per combat.

rows.name: Puresteel Paladin
rows.text: with three artifacts every Equipment has equip {0}. This is what makes Colossus Hammer a one-mana card instead of a nine-mana card.

rows.name: Colossus Hammer
rows.text: +10/+10 for one mana, if you never pay the equip cost. Cloud goes from 2/1 to 12/11 and the game usually ends two turns later.

rows.name: Sigarda's Aid
rows.text: Equipment gains flash and attaches itself for free when it enters. Flash the Hammer on after blockers are declared.

rows.name: Hammer of Nazahn
rows.text: auto-attaches every Equipment that arrives, and the wearer is indestructible.

rows.name: Forge Anew
rows.text: a free equip each turn, equipping at instant speed, and it reanimates an Equipment from the graveyard on entry.

rows.name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
rows.text: moves any number of Auras and Equipment for free at the start of combat. Rebuild your entire Voltron in one step after a bounce or a blink.

rows.name: Codsworth, Handy Helper
rows.text: white mana that only casts Equipment, a free attach every turn, and your commander gets ward {2}.

rows.name: Cid, Freeflier Pilot
rows.text: Equipment costs one less, he flies on your turn, and he buys Equipment back out of the graveyard.

rows.name: Super-Soldier Serum
rows.text: +2/+2, first strike, vigilance, and it re-attaches every Equipment you control whenever the creature attacks OR blocks.

guide.title: Making it lethal in one swing

rows.text: Cloud is the commander, so twenty-one damage from him ends a player outright. That number is reachable on the turn you assemble it, not several turns later.

rows.name: Brotherhood Regalia
rows.text: equip to a legendary creature for {1}: ward {2} and CANNOT BE BLOCKED. This is the enabler — a 12/11 unblockable Cloud with double strike is twenty-four commander damage.

rows.name: Commander's Plate
rows.text: +3/+3 and protection from blue, black, red and green, because none of those are in your identity. Nothing but a white blocker can stop it and almost no removal can touch it.

rows.name: Excalibur, Sword of Eden
rows.text: +10/+0, and its cost falls by the total mana value of your historic permanents — which in an artifact deck full of legends is most of it.

rows.name: Genji Glove
rows.text: double strike and a second combat phase, so the same lethal swing happens twice.

rows.name: Swordsman's Steel
rows.text: draws a card per Equipment when it lands and gives +2/+2 per Equipment. On a full Voltron board it is often +10/+10 and four cards.

rows.name: Shadowspear
rows.text: trample and lifelink, and for {1} it strips indestructible and hexproof off their blockers.

rows.name: Mantle of the Ancients
rows.text: returns every Equipment and Aura in your graveyard to the battlefield attached, then pumps by all of them. This is the rebuild after a wrath.

rows.name: The Aetherspark
rows.text: attaches itself, cannot be attacked, and stores loyalty off combat damage until it draws two or makes ten mana.

rows.name: Stoneforge Mystic
rows.text: fetch, then cheat the expensive Equipment onto the battlefield for two mana.

rows.name: Stonehewer Giant
rows.text: repeatable — every turn it finds an Equipment and attaches it, for two mana, at instant speed if you leave it up.

rows.name: Steelshaper's Gift
rows.text: one mana for any Equipment in the deck.

rows.name: Open the Armory
rows.text: the same, and it also finds Mantle of the Ancients or Super-Soldier Serum.

rows.name: Armored Skyhunter
rows.text: digs six on every attack and puts the Equipment straight onto the battlefield attached.

rows.name: Recruiter of the Guard
rows.text: finds Puresteel Paladin, Giver of Runes, Stoneforge Mystic or Ranger-Captain of Eos.

rows.name: Ranger-Captain of Eos
rows.text: finds a one-drop, and sacrifices to stop every noncreature spell for a turn — which is how you protect the lethal swing.

rows.name: Adaptive Omnitool
rows.text: digs six for an artifact on each attack, twice with Cloud.
The failure mode of Voltron is one removal spell answering eight cards. Half the deck exists to make that impossible.

rows.name: Giver of Runes
rows.text: protection from a colour or from colourless for Cloud, every single turn, for one mana.

rows.name: Mithril Coat
rows.text: flash, indestructible, and it attaches itself to a legendary creature the moment it enters. Hold it up as a counterspell for removal.

rows.name: Swiftfoot Boots
rows.text: hexproof and haste, and haste matters because Cloud gets recast constantly.

rows.name: Restoration Magic
rows.text: one mana for hexproof and indestructible, or four for the whole board.

rows.name: Clever Concealment
rows.text: usually free with convoke. Phases out your permanents WITH everything attached to them.

rows.name: Teferi's Protection
rows.text: the full reset against a wrath or a combo kill.

rows.name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
rows.text: counters anything cast for free, and sacrifices to make the board indestructible.

rows.name: Grand Abolisher
rows.text: opponents cannot cast spells or activate abilities during your turn. Cast this before the alpha strike.

rows.name: Voice of Victory
rows.text: the same lockout plus two attacking bodies every combat.

rows.name: Silence
rows.text: one mana on your turn and nobody can interact at all.

rows.name: Trouble in Pairs
rows.text: draws you a card every time an opponent doubles up, and it shuts off extra turns entirely.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares
rows.text: the best one-mana answer in the format.

rows.name: Path to Exile
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Dispatch
rows.text: one mana to exile with metalcraft, which is always on here.

rows.name: Solitude
rows.text: free, at instant speed, and Sword of Hearth and Home can blink it back.

rows.name: Generous Gift
rows.text: the answer to anything that is not a creature.

rows.name: Cloud's Limit Break
rows.text: scales with your mana — one tapped creature, several across different players, or every tapped creature on the table after they have all attacked.

rows.name: Single Combat
rows.text: everyone keeps one permanent and nobody can cast creatures until your next turn. In a Voltron deck the one you keep is worth more than their one.

rows.name: Witch Enchanter
rows.text: an artifact or enchantment killed on entry, and it is a land on the other side when you do not need the effect.

rows.name: Galadriel's Dismissal
rows.text: phases out a blocker, or kicked, an entire player's creatures — either a defensive save or the clear for a lethal swing.

rows.name: Reprieve
rows.text: not a counterspell, but it bounces the spell and draws, which buys the turn you needed.

rows.name: Land Tax
rows.text: in a deck this cheap you will be behind on lands often, and three basics a turn fuels Archaeomancer's Map and Sword of the Animist.

rows.name: Archaeomancer's Map
rows.text: two Plains on entry, then free land drops whenever an opponent out-lands you.

rows.name: Mox Amber
rows.text: live from turn two onwards because your commander costs two.

rows.name: Mox Opal
rows.text: metalcraft is trivial here.

rows.name: Smothering Tithe
rows.text: the Treasures pay equip costs the free-equip effects do not cover.

rows.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
rows.text: a card for every Equipment, Aura or Vehicle spell you cast.

rows.name: Esper Sentinel
rows.text: taxes their first noncreature spell each turn, and grows when you equip it.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: protection from everything for a turn — often the turn that saves you — and then an escalating draw engine.

rows.name: Archivist of Oghma
rows.text: a card and a life every time anyone fetches or tutors.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a free-equip enabler. Puresteel Paladin, Sigarda's Aid or Hammer of Nazahn with any cheap Equipment is a keep; a hand of expensive gear with no way to attach it is not.

rows.name: Cloud, Midgar Mercenary
rows.text: cast him early and often. He is two mana and he tutors on every cast, so recasting him after removal is a card, not a setback — you are usually happy to trade a removal spell for a fresh Equipment tutor.
Do not attach everything before you can protect it. One Giver of Runes activation or a Mithril Coat in hand is worth more than an extra Sword on the pile.

rows.name: Brotherhood Regalia
rows.text: the piece to look for once Colossus Hammer is on. Unblockable is what converts a big Cloud into twenty-one commander damage this turn instead of next turn.
